facts.fact: Dayspring Law Firm states Cameroon's General Tax Code gives eligible innovative ICT start-ups a five-year full tax exemption then a further five years of reduced company tax (15%) and a 30% research tax credit.
facts.system: General Tax Code innovative start-up incentives

facts.fact: Dayspring Law Firm states start-ups must be approved by state-approved management centres, usually business incubators, before they can benefit from the tax incentives.

systems.system: General Tax Code innovative start-up incentives
systems.tiers: incubation phase 0-5 years; operational phase 5-10 years
